title: 第312章 专挑人少下手第311章 我们俩的身份
content_zh:
老苏吸了口烟，在一片缭绕的青烟中，神色凝重地点了点头。
“没错，出大事了，而且是大乱子。”
老苏将手中的烟蒂狠狠地按灭在烟灰缸里，发出一声叹息。
瘫在蛟龙皮沙发上的陈邪，无精打采地打了个哈欠，抓了抓乱糟糟的头发，满脸不爽地抱怨起来。
“何止是大乱子。”
陈邪撇了撇嘴，语气里充满了怨念，“就在今晚，大夏各地的749分局全都炸开锅了。各地纷纷上报，出现了不同程度的古修士袭击事件。”
陈邪翻了个白眼，继续吐槽：“这帮老帮菜也是真够阴的，专挑人少、偏僻的地方下手！小爷本来泡澡泡得正舒坦呢，结果被老苏一个夺命连环催硬生生给喊来了，泡个澡都不能安宁。”
一听这话，萧逸顿时来了精神，他凑上前去，拍了拍陈邪的肩膀，打趣道：“哟！老陈，这就是你的不对了啊！泡澡这种舒坦事，怎么都不叫上兄弟几个一起去享受享受？自己躲起来吃独食，过分了啊！”
还没等陈邪开口，蹲在茶几上的大白直接翻了个白眼，那眼神就像是在看一个急着投胎的白痴。
“嘎！你是不是脑子进水了想寻死啊？”
“你以为那小子泡的是什么正经的温泉浴吗？白爷告诉你，他泡的那是他亲手调制的万毒淬体液！”
大白心有余悸地缩了缩脖子，绘声绘色地描述起来：“那池子里的水，全都是用什么黑心蜘蛛、万年蜈蚣涎、还有剧毒腐尸水熬出来的！别说是你这种细皮嫩肉的法修了，白爷我身为化神大妖，凑近闻上一口都得拉上三天三夜的肚子！你还想去泡？进去连根骨头渣子都给你溶了！”
萧逸听完大白的描述，脑海中顿时浮现出那个恐怖的画面，浑身的鸡皮疙瘩都竖了起来。
他尴尬地缩了缩脖子，干笑两声：“咳咳……那什么，这澡……这澡还真不是非泡不可，老陈你自己慢慢享受，我就不凑这个热闹了。”
看着这帮人在这种危机时刻还有心情在这互相调侃，老苏痛苦地揉了揉隐隐作痛的太阳穴。
“行了行了！都什么时候了，你们几个还有心情在这里开玩笑？！”
老苏用力拍了拍办公桌，沉声喝道，“都给我把嘴闭上，别贫嘴了！这事现在已经彻底闹大了！”
“总部那边已经下达了最高级别的死命令！不惜一切代价，必须在最短的时间内查清这帮古修士突然集体复苏出世的缘由！同时，对于所有敢在世俗界闹事的古修士……见一个，灭一个！”
张怀道面色肃穆，开口说道：“苏处长所言极是，我师傅也紧急传信给了小道。”
张怀道神色罕见地带着几分忌惮：“师傅在信中特意叮嘱，说此事背后透着古怪，牵扯甚广，而且极其危险！师傅严令小道，这段时间必须紧紧跟在师叔的身边，寸步不离。”

听到老天师的传信，陈邪翘起二郎腿，满脸得意地笑了笑：“嘿，要不说还得是老天师呢，这眼力劲就是绝。知道在这大夏修真界，待在小爷我身边才是最安全的。”
“这还用查什么缘由？！”
林小蛮一巴掌拍在背后的剑匣上。
剑匣大开，剑意瞬间弥漫整个办公室。
林小蛮柳眉倒竖，满脸的暴躁与杀气：“苏哥！按姑奶奶我的意思，就该直接杀出去！这群死不透的老棺材瓤子，竟然敢大半夜的打扰姑奶奶做美梦！”
林小蛮磨着牙，恶狠狠地说道：“不把他们找出来，一剑一剑地砍成一百零八段，根本解不了我心头之气！”
苏深吸了一口气，一口气把肺里的最后一点烟雾全部吐尽，脸上写满了疲惫与无奈。
“唉……”老苏长叹一声，语气中带着深深的无力感，“你们以为我不想砍了他们？白天刚把生命教廷那帮长翅膀的鸟人的事给解决了，老子连口热水都没喝上，这大半夜的又冒出这么一档子事。这修行界的破事，难道就不能消停两天，让老子好好睡个整觉吗？！”
萧逸收起了嬉皮笑脸，神色凝重地看着老苏问道：“苏哥，抱怨归抱怨，现在这局面，咱们西开分局到底该怎么办？总不能就在办公室里干坐着等他们打上门来吧？”
老苏站起身，双手撑在办公桌上，目光扫视过众人，“按照总部的意思，大夏各地所有749分局所管辖的区域，即刻起，启动预警大阵！”
老苏咬着牙，一字一顿地说道：“只要大阵内探查到任何一个古修士灵力波动，不用汇报，不用留活口！出现一个，杀一个！”
悟德瞪大了眼睛，惊呼出声：“启动预警大阵？！！苏哥，这局势真的有这么严重吗？！”
悟德摸着自己的光头，满脸的心痛与肉疼：“那可是大型结界阵法啊！那大阵只要一启动，一天什么都不干，光是维持阵法运转，就要消耗足足一万颗极品灵石啊！这可都是白花花的灵石啊，就这么烧了？”
老苏深吸一口带着尼古丁，声音微微发颤：“根据总部传来的最新情报，就这短短的一个晚上的时间……大夏各地，已经有不下十个化神境的大能修士，遭受了这群古修士的毒手！”
“而且……”老苏咽了一口唾沫，“所有遭遇毒手的地方，现场除了恐怖的打斗痕迹之外，连一滴血、一块布料都没有留下！那些化神境……全部尸骨无存，就像是从这个世界上凭空蒸发了一样！”
“总部怀疑，这群古修士如此大张旗鼓，怕不是要血祭什么东西！！”
“什么？！！！”
萧逸倒吸一口凉气，说道：“我靠……一晚上，十个化神境？尸骨无存？！这帮老古董……到底是有多狠啊？！”

content_en:
Lao Su took a puff of his cigarette and nodded solemnly amidst the lingering smoke.
"Yes, something big happened, and it was a big mess."
Lao Su pressed the cigarette butt in his hand hard into the ashtray and let out a sigh.
Chen Xie, who was slumped on the dragon leather sofa, yawned listlessly, scratched his messy hair, and complained with an unhappy face.
"It's more than just a big mess."
Chen Xie curled his lips, his tone full of resentment, "Just tonight, all the 749 branches in Daxia exploded. Reports have been reported from all over the country, and there have been varying degrees of attacks by ancient monks."
Chen Xie rolled his eyes and continued to complain: "These old gangsters are really shady. They specialize in remote places with few people to attack! The young master was enjoying a good bath, but he was suddenly called out by Lao Su. He couldn't rest peacefully even after taking a bath."
Upon hearing this, Xiao Yi immediately became energetic. He walked forward, patted Chen Xie on the shoulder, and joked: "Hey! Old Chen, this is your fault! Why don't you invite your brothers to enjoy such a relaxing thing as taking a bath? Hiding away and eating alone is too much!"
Before Chen Xie could speak, Dabai, who was squatting on the coffee table, rolled his eyes, as if he was looking at an idiot who was eager to reincarnate.
"Gah! Are you out of your mind and want to die?"
"Do you think that boy took a serious hot spring bath? Mr. Bai told you that the Ten Thousand Poison Tempering Body Liquid he prepared himself!"
Dabai shrank his neck with lingering fear, and described it vividly: "The water in the pool is made of black-hearted spiders, ten thousand-year-old centipede saliva, and highly toxic carrion water! Not to mention you, a practitioner of fine-skinned and tender flesh. As a great demon incarnation, Master Bai, I would be sick for three days and three nights even if I took a sip of it! You still want to take a dip? Even the bones and slag will be dissolved for you if you go in!"
After Xiao Yi listened to Dabai's description, the terrifying scene suddenly appeared in his mind, and goosebumps stood up all over his body.
He shrank his neck in embarrassment and laughed dryly: "Ahem...what, this bath...this bath is really not mandatory. Lao Chen, you can enjoy it yourself, I won't join in the fun."
Seeing that this group of people were still in the mood to tease each other at this critical moment, Lao Su painfully rubbed his aching temples.
"Okay, okay! What time is it, and you guys are still in the mood to joke around here?!"
Lao Su patted the desk hard and shouted in a deep voice, "Shut your mouth and stop talking! This matter has become a big deal now!"
"The highest-level death order has been issued from the headquarters! At any cost, we must find out the reason why these ancient monks suddenly resurrected collectively in the shortest possible time! At the same time, for all the ancient monks who dare to make trouble in the secular world... see one and destroy each one!"
Zhang Huaidao looked solemn and said, "What Director Su said is absolutely true. My master also sent an urgent message to Xiaodao."
Zhang Huaidao's expression showed a rare hint of fear: "Master specifically warned me in the letter that there is something weird behind this matter, it is very involved, and it is extremely dangerous! Master strictly ordered us to stay on the right path, and we must stay close to my uncle during this period of time."
After hearing the message from the old Celestial Master, Chen Xie crossed his legs and smiled proudly: "Hey, I would have to be the old Celestial Master. His eyesight is amazing. I know that in this Daxia cultivation world, staying with me is the safest."
"Why do we need to find out the reason?!"
Lin Xiaoman slapped the sword box behind his back.
The sword box opened wide, and the sword intent instantly filled the entire office.
Lin Xiaoman's eyebrows were raised, and his face was full of irritability and murderous intent: "Brother Su! According to my aunt, I should kill him directly! These old coffin bastards dare to disturb my aunt's sweet dreams in the middle of the night!"
Lin Xiaoman gritted his teeth and said viciously: "If we don't find them and chop them into 108 pieces with one sword, there's no way I can relieve the anger in my heart! "
Su took a deep breath and exhaled all the last bits of smoke in her lungs, her face full of exhaustion and helplessness.
"Alas..." Old Su sighed, with a deep sense of powerlessness in his tone, "You think I don't want to kill them? During the day, we just settled the matter with those winged birdmen from the Holy See of Life. I didn't even have a drink of hot water. This happened again in the middle of the night. Can't this messy thing in the spiritual world stop for two days and let me have a good night's sleep? ! "
Xiao Yi put away his playful smile, looked at Lao Su with a solemn expression and asked: "Brother Su, complaining is just complaining. In this situation, what should we do at the Xikai Branch? You can't just sit in the office and wait for them to knock on the door, right? "
Lao Su stood up, put his hands on his desk, and glanced at everyone, "According to the instructions of the headquarters, all areas under the jurisdiction of the 749 branch in Daxia will activate the early warning array immediately! "
Lao Su gritted his teeth and said word by word: "As long as any ancient monk's spiritual power fluctuation is detected in the formation, there is no need to report it, and there is no need to leave him alive! If one appears, kill one! "
Wude's eyes widened and he exclaimed: "Activate the early warning array? ! ! Brother Su, is this situation really that serious? ! "
Wu De touched his bald head, his face full of heartache and physical pain: "That is a large-scale barrier formation! As long as the formation is activated, it will do nothing for a day. Just to maintain the operation of the formation, it will consume a full 10,000 top-quality spiritual stones! These are all white spiritual stones, just burned like this? "
Lao Su took a deep breath with nicotine, and his voice trembled slightly: "According to the latest information from the headquarters, in just one night... no less than ten powerful monks in the God Transformation Realm across Daxia have suffered from the vicious hands of these ancient monks! "
"And..." Lao Su swallowed, "In all the places where he was attacked by murderers, apart from the horrific traces of fighting, not even a drop of blood or a piece of cloth was left behind! Those in the realm of transformation...all the corpses were gone, as if they had evaporated out of thin air from this world! "
"Headquarters suspects that these ancient monks are so grandiose that they are not asking for a blood sacrifice! ! "
"What? ! ! ! "
Xiao Yi took a breath of cold air and said: "Holy crap...ten gods in one night? No bones left? ! How ruthless are these old antiques? ! "
